class Window_MainWindow { constructor() { this.name = "MainWindow"; this.title = "Quick Kinetic Window"; this.width = 800; this.height = 600; } create() { console.log('[WINDOW] Created window: MainWindow'); } start() { console.log('[WINDOW] Started window event loop: MainWindow'); } close() { console.log('[WINDOW] Closed window: MainWindow'); } function doThis() { console.log("Executing custom window action doThis()"); } }; const MainWindow = new Window_MainWindow(); function main() { let window = "MainWindow"; let name = window; name.create(); name.start(); name.doThis(); }
